name: Schaefer
bio: Schaefer was a billiards champion whose matches with Slosson and Vignaux the Cow Boy followed in its sporting notes, including his loss to Slosson at Chicago in 1884. In December 1885 the paper reported that he had taken first prize in the world championship series.

moments.label: Lost to Slosson at balk-line billiards in Chicago

mentions: …wo scores, the best on record. Fitzgerald made 610 miles and Rowell 602. Poor Eo was badly left.  Slosson and Schæfer are said to be making higher averages in their preliminary play for their coming billiard contest than have ever been made before. Betting is slightly in favor of Schæfe…

…ds. Barnes' time was 7 seconds.  Slosson realized the highest expectations of his friends in his contest with Schaeffer at Chicago last Sunday night, and beat the champion, at the balk-line game of billiards. Betting was $125 to $40 on Schaeffer and large sums were laid at these odds.
Slosson, Shaefer and Vignaux will begin next Monday a series of games to decide the billiard championship of the world. This time the games will be continued until one is victor.
The billiard championship of the world has been decided. Schæfer took first prize, Vignaux second and Slosson third.
